issue.title: Split embedded assets into a bob-obsidian-assets crate before the package outgrows the size cap
issue.description:
Move the large embedded third-party assets (web-clip fonts under
`scripts/web_clip/fonts/`, `scripts/web_clip/vendor/mermaid.min.js`,
`scripts/web_clip/vendor/defuddle.full.js`, and the large `assets/` payloads) into a
separate `bob-obsidian-assets` crate that `bob-obsidian` depends on, so each crate stays
well under crates.io's 10 MiB compressed cap. `just package-check`
(`tools/release/package_check.py`) measured the `bob-obsidian` .crate at 7.77–7.79 MiB
on 2026-10-20/21 (bob-cli-ac.2 and .4 notes). It warns above 8 MiB (a `::warning::` in
CI's package job) and fails above 9 MiB, so about 0.2 MiB of headroom is left. Design
questions: keep `include_bytes!` access, version the assets crate separately or in
lockstep, and decide whether release-plz handles the assets crate in the same workspace.
Note that `docs/develop/releases/keep-the-package-under-the-size-cap.md` documents this
escalation and forbids `publish_no_verify`. Proposed by bob-cli-ac.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP
note #3). That note framed the trigger as GitHub Release archive limits. The real
constraint is the crate-size gate, not Release assets (GitHub allows 2 GiB per asset).

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
The release-train epic bob-cli-ac explicitly ruled the assets split out of scope, and
its decision record names "the size cap forces the assets split" as a reopen trigger.
The package is ~0.2 MiB under the 8 MiB warning, so the split needs planning before CI
starts warning and then failing.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ac.8 proposed an assets split; just package-check measures the crate at ~7.79 MiB against an 8 MiB warning and 9 MiB failure, so the split needs planning soon.

payload.description: Release-train epic that added just package-check and ruled the assets split out of scope
Need the package size cap this phase must measure against

payload.entry: TRIAGE 2026-10-27: latest green master package job (run 40552594864, bab568fc, v0.4.0) measured the bob-obsidian .crate at 8,216,260 bytes (7.84 MiB, 78.4% of the 10 MiB cap), up from 7.77–7.79 MiB on 2026-10-20/21. That leaves about 0.16 MiB before package_check.py's 8 MiB warning and about 1.16 MiB before its 9 MiB failure.
